introduction.p1: Welcome to my portfolio. Here you will find my personal and academic projects, developed since my early days.
introduction.p2: I mainly design complete web applications with React, Express.js or Next.js, with the aim of specializing as a full stack developer.

services.title: REST API
services.p: Development of systems that allow information to be easily exchanged with other departments.

services.title: UI/UX Design
services.p: Creating simple, clear and modern designs so users can find what they are looking for in just a few clicks.

services.title: Deployment
services.p: Implementing tools that allow you to easily update a site or app.

projects.title: Multiplayer Strategy Board Game
projects.name: Conquete
projects.desc: Creation of a strategic board game in Java, integrating AI for local multiplayer games, save game management, and generation of statistical graphs for the games.

projects.title: Educational App for Students
projects.name: PythonApp
projects.desc: Development of an interactive Python application to teach programming to students. The application includes a code editor, real-time feedback generation, and storage of student statistics.

projects.title: Air Traffic Simulator
projects.name: Aeerial
projects.desc: Development of an air traffic simulator in Java, including a real-time configurable graphical interface and using advanced concepts such as trajectory calculation and collision avoidance (multithreading).
